sloka: सह शूरैर्हरिगणैर्लब्धसञ्ज्ञावरिन्दमौ ।गच्छ त्वं भ्रातरौ गृह्य किष्किन्धां रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.५०.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: saha śūrairharigaṇairlabdhasañjñāvarindamau ।gaccha tvaṁ bhrātarau gṛhya kiṣkindhāṁ rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.50.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "On regaining consciousness, take the brothers Rama and Lakshmana, the tamers of enemies to Kishkinda accompanied by the heroic monkey army."
